quantifiers_checked.s: every integer s>=4, including even and odd parity
quantifiers_checked.n: every integer n>=0, including n=0,1 and n>=2

completion_distinction: The abstract polynomial completion is not canonically identical to the operator domain under polynomial representatives, but the boundary-correcting map is a unitary equivalence.
density_distinction: The literal polynomial span is not a subspace of the operator domain. The genuine K_c^{-r} images all lie in the operator domain and have dense span.
editorial_note: The phrase two-dimensional affine space should read two-dimensional linear space of affine functions; the formula span{1,x} is correct and this is not a proof gap.
